title: Speaking — Music at home
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on music at home.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
What music do you usually listen to indoors?
Have your music preferences changed recently?

part2.topic: Describe a piece of music you associate with a particular memory.
part2.closing: and explain why the connection has lasted.

questions: Why do some songs become important to a whole generation?
Should public money help people attend local music performances?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to music at home?
